units.source_text: 宇治两女公子日日盼待匂亲王来到，觉得此次隔绝如此长久，可知终于被遗弃了，不胜悲伤。

en.t: The two young ladies of Uji waited day after day for Prince Niou to come, and when this separation seemed to have lasted so long, they felt that they must at last have been abandoned, and were overcome with sorrow.

units.source_text: 正在此时，薰中纳言来访。

en.t: Just then, Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, came to visit.

units.source_text: 他是闻知大女公子患病，前来探望的。

en.t: He had heard that the elder young lady was ill and had come to inquire after her.

units.source_text: 大女公子的病其实并不十分沉重，但也借此为由，谢绝会面。

en.t: The elder young lady's illness was not in fact very serious, but she used it as a reason to decline seeing him.

units.source_text: 薰中纳言说：“惊悉玉体违和，远道前来探望。

en.t: Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, said, "I was alarmed to hear that you were unwell, and have come this long way to pay my respects and ask after you.
I beg you to allow me to come near your sickbed."
He was sincerely worried and pressed his request earnestly.

units.source_text: 侍女们只得引导他到大女公子随意寝息之处的帘前。

en.t: The waiting women had no choice but to lead him to the curtain before the place where the elder young lady was resting at ease.

units.source_text: 大女公子觉得讨厌，颇感痛苦，但也并不生嗔，坐起身来答话。

en.t: The elder young lady found this disagreeable and felt considerable distress, but she did not become angry; she sat up and answered him.

units.source_text: 薰中纳言向她详述那天匂亲王过门不入的原由，表明非出本意。

en.t: Kaoru explained to her in detail why Prince Niou had passed her gate that day without entering, making clear that it had not been his intention.

units.source_text: 最后劝道：“务请宽心静待，切勿悲伤怨恨。”

en.t: At last he urged her, "Please set your mind at ease and wait calmly; do not grieve or bear resentment."

units.source_text: 大女公子答道：“舍妹亦并不何等怨恨。

en.t: The elder young lady replied, "My younger sister is not especially resentful.

units.source_text: 只是先父在世之时，屡次训诫我们切勿结婚，如今想起了不免伤心耳。”

en.t: It is only that, when our late father was alive, he repeatedly admonished us never to marry, and now that we remember this, we cannot help feeling sad."
When she finished speaking, a sound like weeping seemed to be heard.

units.source_text: 薰中纳言十分同情，觉得自己也很难以为情，便说道：“世间无论何事都不简单，未可率尔推断。

en.t: Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, felt deep sympathy, and finding the matter painful for himself as well, said, "Nothing in this world is simple, and one must not judge rashly.

units.source_text: 君等不悉世情，难免偏执己见，空劳怨恨。

en.t: Since you do not fully know the ways of the world, you are liable to cling to your own view and trouble yourselves with needless resentment.
Please do your utmost to compose yourselves.
I am certain that in this matter there is no cause for concern."

units.source_text: 他回想对他人之事也如此关怀，自己觉得纳罕。

en.t: When he reflected that he was showing such concern even for another person's affairs, he found it strange himself.
